purpose: bounded learning-effect trial, not full dataset acceptance
source_rule: Fresh generated pixels only; fitted styles are shared development knowledge. Original capture pixels and derivatives stay development only.
split_rule: Open labels disjoint by stable hash; original item templates split by identity. No finite-label overlap exception needed in this version.
held_out_rule: Reserved label partition, frozen evaluation images, held-out theme and final evaluation source remain excluded.
pilot_review: 30 examples across six families visually inspected in core-trial-pilot-v2; full pilot 288 images replayed, source/encoding/split checked; exact game font identity remains unconfirmed
